mapping.summary: Native Android barcode scanning for receiving, putaway, picking, transfers and counting.
claims: Runs fully inside BC without middleware or an external WMS
Validates each scan in real time before posting
Covers receiving, putaway, picking, shipping, reclassification and internal movements
Transfers between locations, bins or warehouses
Cycle counting and direct stock corrections
Shows item images on the scanner during receiving and picking
Checks scans against item, location, batch or serial, pallet and allowed actions
Interface built for industrial Android scanners
Can fall back to a smartphone camera when no handheld is available
Wi-Fi drops do not reset active workflows
Reads GS1 and SSCC barcode structures
Handles batch, lot and expiry dates
Identifies pallets, containers and logistic units
Prints item, pallet and logistic unit labels from BC with Zebra, NiceLabel and BarTender
